content:
anya: FYI onboarding q4k-kraken -> mixed KR+ZH samples show spaces injected inside Chinese name after quant run. BLEU locally ~-6 vs fp16. anyone seen spacing-in-ideograph issues? :grimace:
mike: paste minimal input and detok pls
anya: input: `KR: 그는 서울에 갔다. ZH: 他去了首尔。` -> translate to en
chen: token dump (quant path) shows extra split tokens: detok becomes "...他去了 首 尔 。" vs baseline "...他去了首尔。"
hiro: did you try legacy tokenizer flag?
mike: with use_legacy_tokenizer=True detok and BLEU match baseline (delta ~-0.3). points to runtime/quant vocab remap or merge kernel change.
eval-bot: quick eval n=1200: BLEU fp16=32.8 q4k=26.8 (delta -6.0); chrF -0.044; token-split +2.7% (report s3://redwood-evals/1765432100/krzh-quant.html)
anya: bisection shows regression introduced in runtime/kernel_selector commit 0f3e9a (quant-vocab remap). plan: implement compatibility shim preserving CJK merge thresholds for remap path, add mixed KR/ZH smoke test to canary. opening PR fix/quant-cjk-merge-shim and ticket. tagging @chen @hiro @mike for review.
chen: i'll add unit + canary integration and post artifacts. mike: shim keeps perf win (~-3% latency) while restoring quality, good call.
anya: thanks, will follow up with PR link + eval artifacts. :thumbsup:
